title: Title BGM (zero input)
notes: Scenario 1 of the C-R2.3 matrix. Zero input: the attract-mode / title trigger is
sample-position-driven, so the title BGM sequence is already deterministic given the
two RNG pins. GDX_AUDIO_THREAD=0 forces the legacy fiber audio path (the golden path).
96000 frames at 32 kHz is ~3 s of stereo audio — enough to cover the boot-logo riff and
the first bars of the title theme. Adjust capture_frames for a longer window.
